19b3cc49988ea7a3.title: Civil Services Club, IIT Mandi
19b3cc49988ea7a3.summary: The Civil Services Club at IIT Mandi is a new initiative for students interested in the UPSC Civil Services Exam, public administration, policy, governance, and understanding how the country works. The club will offer sessions on exam patterns, preparation strategies, current affairs, talks by civil servants and experts, resource sharing, and community building. All students, regardless of their year or branch, are welcome to join.

19b3c191be758e18.title: Adobe-Verified Internship & Placement Assurance Program 2025
19b3c191be758e18.summary: Students from IIT MANDI are invited to apply for the Adobe Internship and Career Development Program 2025. The program focuses on structured learning aimed at supporting skill development relevant to current industry practices. The program includes: • Practical, project-based learning activities • Development of technical and analytical skills • Academic and professional guidance from mentors • Career preparedness support
